snippet.title: Plug n Play Games: Crayola's My First TV Play System
snippet.description:
Help support the channel: https://www.patreon.com/ZCInfinity


A very simplistic flood fill coloring book console, accompanied by 10 slightly-more-colorful versions of games found in every knockoff TV game console in existence. After playing this, you'll feel like that Homer Simpson X-ray with the crayon lodged in his brain...
